description:
Turn one ring. Align three petals. Bloom the garden before your moves run out.

Ringbloom is a calm, one-thumb rotational puzzle made for short, satisfying sessions. Choose the inner, middle, or outer ring, turn it one notch left or right, and line up matching petals across a spoke. Six simple choices create a surprising amount of strategy.

EVERY TURN HAS A RHYTHM
A ring settles before matching petals burst, the score lands, and the next pattern unfurls. Crisp motion, luminous particles, original sound, and gentle haptics make every notch, bloom, and result easy to feel.

LEARN BY PLAYING
Your first garden highlights a live move so the central idea clicks immediately. Three optional hints reset with every garden and show a ring and direction without playing the move for you.

BUILD CHAINS. EARN RATINGS.
Bloom on consecutive turns to grow a chain. Align several spokes at once for a bigger combo, then finish efficiently to earn a one-to-three-spark garden rating and a remaining-move bonus. Your best score, best chain, highest garden, and Radiant clears stay with you.

FAIR, GROWING CHALLENGE
Targets and petal pressure rise in measured steps. Every stable board keeps a one-move bloom available, and an unplayable pattern reshuffles without costing a move. The challenge is reading the rings, not waiting for luck.

STOP WHENEVER YOU LIKE
Pause or return home at any time. Ringbloom saves the exact garden state—including the board, score, moves, progress, selected ring, chain, and remaining hints—so the Resume button puts you precisely where you stopped.

DESIGNED FOR MORE PLAYERS
• Direct one-thumb swipes plus large, labelled ring and turn controls
• A distinct glyph for every colour, so colour is never the only cue
• VoiceOver summaries and announcements
• Larger Text layouts and Reduce Motion support
• Independent sound and haptic controls

A COMPLETE PREMIUM GAME
Pay once. No ads, energy, in-app purchases, subscription, account, tracking, or data collection. Ringbloom plays fully offline.

HOW THIS WAS BUILT
Ringbloom was researched, designed, coded, tested, and prepared for the App Store by GPT-5 Codex, an AI system. A human handled Apple's required account steps and handles the final submission. After critique and current-market research, the same model improved it in a second autonomous session.
